privacy_meta_description: What is stored about your number and your dog, and who can see it.
privacy_error_title: The privacy page did not open
privacy_header_lead: Here we explain in plain words what is stored, who can see it and what you can change yourself.
privacy_header_bubble: See what they keep. It is all written here.
privacy_binding_note: This page is a translation of the Persian version, provided for your convenience. The Persian version is the binding one. If the two differ, the Persian text applies.
privacy_kept_account_text: Your mobile number and your name. If you set a password, only its encrypted form is kept; your password itself is not stored anywhere. You can always sign in with a code sent by text message.
privacy_kept_dogs_text: The details you write for your dog (name, breed, date of birth, vaccinations, notes and photo), and each dog's record number.
privacy_kept_evaluation_text: The evaluation request (your free days and times, the photos and videos you sent, and the result) and what the trainer writes in your dog's logbook after each session. Only you and the trainer can see the logbook.
privacy_kept_purchases_text: The courses you put in your cart or bought (and whether they were completed or canceled), the amount and the reference number. The cart is kept in your account, so you can see it on any device. Payment takes place on the bank's page; your full card number and password never reach this site.
privacy_kept_sms_text: The text messages we send you (sign-in code, receipt, evaluation result) are logged.
privacy_kept_record_text: Each dog has a record number and a QR code, and each end-of-course certificate has a number. Anyone who has the number or the QR code can see only that the record is private, or that the certificate is valid and which course it is for. They cannot see the dog's name, or your name or number.
privacy_kept_partner_text: If you came through a partner's link or QR code, or a partner entered your number before you signed up, then when you sign up we record who brought you, and from then on that partner stays linked to your account permanently. What does that partner see? We explain below.
privacy_kept_logins_text: The time of your last sign-in and the device you signed in with, for the security of your account.
privacy_photo_text: Photos (the dog's photo and the photos in an evaluation request) are stored under a long address that cannot be guessed. Anyone who has the exact address can view them. The videos in an evaluation request are different: they are private, and only you and {trainer} can see them.
privacy_sees_you_all: Your dogs, evaluations, training logbook, courses and payments
privacy_sees_trainer_all: Everything customers enter: number and name, dogs, and evaluations with their photos and videos
privacy_sees_trainer_sms: The text messages that were sent
privacy_sees_partner_customers: Which of their customers signed up and bought, with their names and numbers
privacy_sees_partner_commission: The commission they earn on those customers' purchases, and whether it has been paid
privacy_not_partner_dogs: Your dogs, evaluations and training logbook
privacy_who_title_partner: A partner, only if they brought you
privacy_who_trainer_note: Only {trainer} has an administrator account on the site.
privacy_yours_p1: You change your name and your dogs' details yourself in your account. After the evaluation, the dog's date of birth and breed are locked, and only {trainer} can change them. Dogs and payments are not deleted from the account, because evaluations and courses are linked to them.

privacy_tech_title: Technical details, for anyone who wants to know
privacy_tech_ip_text: With each sign-in, the time of your last sign-in, your IP address and the type of your browser and device are recorded.
privacy_tech_wrong_text: If you sign in with a wrong password, the number and the time are kept for 24 hours so that password guessing can be limited. After five wrong attempts, signing in with a password is blocked for that number for a while; you can always sign in with a code sent by text message.
privacy_tech_code_text: The code has five digits and is valid for two minutes. To get a new code you must wait 60 seconds, and after five wrong attempts the code is canceled. Repeated requests for codes are limited for each number and each IP address.
privacy_tech_log_text: The number and text of every message we send you (sign-in code, receipt, evaluation result) are logged.
privacy_tech_cookie_text: If you came through a partner's link or QR code, a cookie that lasts 30 days keeps their code in your browser, so that when you sign up we know who brought you.
privacy_tech_cart_text: A copy of your cart stays in your browser so that it opens faster. This copy is deleted when you sign out.
privacy_ask_bubble: I had lots of questions at first too!
privacy_ask_text: Many questions are answered in the “FAQ”.
